## Checklist

- [ ] `yarn typecheck`, `yarn test` and `yarn build` all pass
- [ ] Changeset added (`yarn changeset`) if this is user-facing, or N/A
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` updated if this changes a convention, command or load-bearing decision
- [ ] If Hevy schemas changed: smoke tests run against a real key, not just CI
- [ ] If the HTTP/OAuth surface changed: driven over real HTTP locally, not only unit tests
- [ ] If a user-facing promise changed: `docs/CONNECTOR.md` and the connect page still true
